program.section_heading: Early Childhood Education, Associate in Science Degree for Transfer (AS-T)
outcomes: Students will be eligible and prepared for admission (SB 1440 and Education Code 66746) to California State University system schools.

blocks.name: Plan of Study Grid (CDE major courses)

notes: The REQUIREMENTS tab content is not in the supplied text; only the Overview and the Program Sequence (Cal-GETC plan of study) are present. The block was built from the CDE courses in the plan of study grid, which the page describes as a curriculum map, not the formal requirements list. A reviewer should check the requirements tab.

total_units 24 comes from the overview sentence 'grant students an AS-T degree in Early Childhood Education with 24 units in the major'. The CDE courses in the plan sum to 26.5 units (CDE A201 printed as 3.5 units in the plan; the closed list stores 3), so the plan and the stated major total do not match.
degree_total 60-60.5 is the 'Total Units' printed at the foot of the plan of study grid, which includes Cal-GETC courses.

The plan has an elective row 'ELECTIVE (UC/CSU TRANSFERABLE) 1.5-0'. Footnote 7 says 'VARIES TO REACH MINIMUM 60 TRANSFERABLE UNITS', so electives_fill_degree was set true and no open elective units were recorded. The elective row carries footnote marker 5, apparently a misprint for 7.

HIST A170 or HIST A175, and POLS C1000 (POLS A180) or POLS C1000H, appear in the plan as American Institutions / CSU graduation requirements (or Cal-GETC Area 3B/4 alternatives). They were treated as general education or graduation requirements and not placed in a block.
Footnote 2 refers to 'EC A201', apparently meaning CDE A201.
The page prints one Program Learning Outcome under 'Program Outcome / Program Learning Outcomes', recorded as printed.
